om: Pythons läge mot bandet (METOD M62, BESLUT B86–B88), facit för SwingLabKit BandlageTests. Skrivs av python3 tools/pc/katalog.py --swift.

over_the_top/utan.vad: How far outside the backswing path the hands come down, at three heights.
over_the_top/utan.varfor: Hands moving out toward the ball in the downswing is over the top.

over_the_top/klubba.vad: The angle at the address clubhead from the address shaft line to the clubhead at P6, in the picture.
over_the_top/klubba.varfor: The clubhead above the address shaft plane at P6 is a steep downswing, over the top.
